Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 10 minutes Number of Servings: 8 Ingredients 1 1/2 cups cooked turkey or smoked turkey, diced 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted and chopped 1/2 cup raisins or other dried fruit 3/4 cup celery, chopped (about 1.5 stalks) 1/4 cup diced red or yellow onion (1/4 medium onion) 1/4 cup diced carrot 1/4 cup parsley, chopped (optional) 1 red apple, cored and chopped (about 1 1/2 cups) 1/3 cup low-fat mayonnaise 1 Tablespoon vinegar (cider, red or white) Directions Mix turkey, nuts, raisins, celery, onions, carrots, parsley and apple in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise and vinegar; mix well. Toss meat mixture with dressing and chill. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Serve cold with lettuce and tomato wedges, or use as sandwich filling.
